name: Constrained Octree Refinement
aliases: Constrained Octree Refinement — 2:1 Balance Refinement, Constrained Octree
definition: A refinement strategy that restricts the octree depth-disparity between adjacent nodes to be no greater than one, often used to compare against unconstrained extraction.
summary: Constrained Octree Refinement restricts depth-disparity between adjacent nodes to one, preventing excessive simplification by ensuring a uniform grid structure.
